title.description: What this part does, in a few words

claim.description: What changed in this part and why, in one or two sentences a reader can check against the excerpts

points.description: Short points that support or qualify the claim

path.description: A file's path as the diff names it (its new path when renamed)

note.description: One line: what changed in this file; omit for a file whose change is obvious from the part

files.description: Every file of the diff that belongs to this part, each in one part only

excerpts.description: The hunks worth reading for this part, most telling first

path.description: A file's path as the diff names it (its new path when renamed)

side.description: `new` (the default): lines of the file after the change; `old`: before it, for code the change removes

start.description: The first line of the excerpt

end.description: The last line of the excerpt (at least `start`); keep it short, a few to 30 lines

why.description: One line: what to see in these lines

items.description: Lines of the diff that show what the part claims: the hunk a reviewer should read, not the whole file

eye.description: What deserves the reviewer's eye in this part; omit when nothing does

text.description: What a reviewer should not miss and why: a risk, a judgement call, a behaviour that changed

path.description: A file's path as the diff names it (its new path when renamed)

line.description: The line it is about, on the new side

items.description: A thing worth the reviewer's eye
One part of the change: a piece a reviewer can read and judge on its own

parts.description: The change as a few parts, in the order a reviewer should read them: the part that carries the change first, rote parts (renames, generated files, tests that follow) last
